subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be closed by accepting a larger fixed Control UI history window, or should closure require older-message pagination from `chat.history`?
rationale: Source inspection proves the 100-message cap and backend offset support, but the docs intentionally describe a bounded recent window, so the UX/performance tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require older-message pagination
options.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close this issue only after Control UI can load older history pages on demand.

options.title: Accept a larger fixed window
options.body: Allow the linked 500-message mitigation to close the issue after it lands with real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Require older-message pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the initial payload bounded and close this issue only after Control UI can load older history pages on demand.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-line provenance on the split Control UI chat-history files and is the best available owner for this UX/performance choice.
